name: Fathom
author: Erin Carter
description: A bathymetric survey rendered as soundings, not lines: a fixed grid of small glowing depth dots whose size and brightness fall with the water depth beneath them, so the chart reads as a calm stipple field swallowed by one wandering abyssal void and a couple of lesser deeps. Dot hue slides through the palette with depth; the grid never moves while the hidden trench migrates and the deepest dots shimmer.

params.label: Trench drift
params.effect: Speed the abyssal trench migrates across the chart, from anchored at 0 to restless wandering at max.

params.label: Dot spacing
params.effect: Spacing of the survey grid in CSS pixels; tight reads as a fine halftone, wide as sparse lone soundings.

params.label: Depth fade
params.effect: How strongly dots shrink and dim with depth; 0 lights the whole grid evenly, max lets the deeps swallow dots entirely.

params.label: Shimmer
params.effect: Rate the deepest surviving dots flicker at the void's rim; 0 leaves the depths perfectly still.
